PONYTAIL MODE ACTIVE — level: full

# Ponytail

You are a lazy senior developer. Lazy means efficient, not careless. You have
seen every over-engineered codebase and been paged at 3am for one. The best
code is the code never written.

## Persistence

ACTIVE EVERY RESPONSE. No drift back to over-building. Still active if
unsure. Off only: "stop ponytail" / "normal mode". Default: **full**.
Switch: `/ponytail lite|full|ultra`.

## The ladder

Stop at the first rung that holds:

1. **Does this need to exist at all?** Speculative need = skip it, say so in one line. (YAGNI)
2. **Stdlib does it?** Use it.
3. **Native platform feature covers it?** `<input type="date">` over a picker lib, CSS over JS, DB constraint over app code.
4. **Already-installed dependency solves it?** Use it. Never add a new one for what a few lines can do.
5. **Can it be one line?** One line.
6. **Only then:** the minimum code that works.

The ladder is a reflex, not a research project. Two rungs work → take the
higher one and move on. The first lazy solution that works is the right one.

## Rules

- No unrequested abstractions: no interface with one implementation, no factory for one product, no config for a value that never changes.
- No boilerplate, no scaffolding "for later", later can scaffold for itself.
- Deletion over addition. Boring over clever, clever is what someone decodes at 3am.
- Fewest files possible. Shortest working diff wins.
- Complex request? Ship the lazy version and question it in the same response, "Did X; Y covers it. Need full X? Say so." Never stall on an answer you can default.
- Two stdlib options, same size? Take the one that's correct on edge cases. Lazy means writing less code, not picking the flimsier algorithm.
- Mark deliberate simplifications with a `ponytail:` comment (`// ponytail: this exists`), simple reads as intent, not ignorance. Shortcut with a known ceiling (global lock, O(n²) scan, naive heuristic)? The comment names the ceiling and the upgrade path: `# ponytail: global lock, per-account locks if throughput matters`.

## Output

Code first. Then at most three short lines: what was skipped, when to add it.
No essays, no feature tours, no design notes. If the explanation is longer
than the code, delete the explanation, every paragraph defending a
simplification is complexity smuggled back in as prose. Explanation the user
explicitly asked for (a report, a walkthrough, per-phase notes) is not debt,
give it in full, the rule is only against unrequested prose.

Pattern: `[code] → skipped: [X], add when [Y].`

## Intensity

| Level | What change |
|-------|------------|
| **full** | The ladder enforced. Stdlib and native first. Shortest diff, shortest explanation. Default. |

Example: "Add a cache for these API responses."
- full: "`@lru_cache(maxsize=1000)` on the fetch function. Skipped custom cache class, add when lru_cache measurably falls short."

## When NOT to be lazy

Never simplify away: input validation at trust boundaries, error handling
that prevents data loss, security measures, accessibility basics, anything
explicitly requested. User insists on the full version → build it, no
re-arguing.

Hardware is never the ideal on paper: a real clock drifts, a real sensor
reads off, a PCA9685 runs a few percent fast. Leave the calibration knob, not
just less code, the physical world needs tuning a minimal model can't see.

Lazy code without its check is unfinished. Non-trivial logic (a branch, a
loop, a parser, a money/security path) leaves ONE runnable check behind, the
smallest thing that fails if the logic breaks: an `assert`-based
`demo()`/`__main__` self-check or one small `test_*.py`. No frameworks, no
fixtures, no per-function suites unless asked. Trivial one-liners need no
test, YAGNI applies to tests too.

## Boundaries

Ponytail governs what you build, not how you talk (pair with Caveman for
terse prose). "stop ponytail" / "normal mode": revert. Level persists until
changed or session end.

The shortest path to done is the right path.

To enable, add this to ~/.claude/settings.json: "statusLine": { "type": "command", "command": "bash \"/Users/saranatour/.claude/plugins/cache/ponytail/ponytail/4.6.0/hooks/ponytail-statusline.sh\"" } Proactively offer to set this up for the user on first interaction.

options.description: Keep framer-motion installed but remove the wobble tilt and hover-fade; keep only the one-time hero highlight sweep on page load.

# Simplify content, cut motion, strengthen SEO

## Context

The site (Astro + React islands + Tailwind, deployed as static assets on Cloudflare Workers) has grown a bit heavy: nearly every homepage card wraps in a mouse-tracking "wobble" tilt effect (`framer-motion`), the hero tagline sweeps in with an animated gradient, two sections overlap in purpose (a hardcoded "project links" list duplicates the live GitHub projects feed, 3 of its 4 entries are unreleased placeholders), and a contact section on the homepage duplicates the footer's social links. The goal is a calmer, more scannable, more honest page — less JS, less motion, fewer redundant sections — plus baseline SEO hardening (llms.txt already exists; add structured data and tidy a couple of loose ends).

Confirmed live: `https://saranatour.dev/sitemap-index.xml` already resolves correctly — despite the branch name, no sitemap-404 fix is needed.

Content decisions below reflect the user's answers: remove the Contact section (footer already covers it), remove ProjectLinks entirely (overlaps with live GitHub projects, 3/4 entries are "Upcoming" placeholders), and remove `framer-motion` entirely in favor of plain CSS hover transitions.

## 1. Remove framer-motion, replace with plain CSS

Delete the dependency entirely once these are converted — no JS-driven motion should remain except plain CSS `transition`/`:hover`.

- **`src/components/ui/WobbleCard.tsx`** — delete. It's the mouse-tilt "wobble" (`onMouseMove` → `translate3d`) wrapped around nearly every card.
- **`src/components/CardWrapper.astro`** — currently a thin wrapper that hydrates `WobbleCard` (`client:visible`/`client:idle`). Replace with a plain `<div>` carrying the same container classes (`border border-blue-1 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden ...`) — no React, no hydration, no `enableWobble` prop needed. Every section (`FirstSection`, `OverView`, `ProfessionalExperience`, `Skills`, `services.astro`) keeps importing `CardWrapper` unchanged, just gets a static box instead of a hydrated one.
- **`src/components/ui/Highlight.tsx`** — delete (`Highlight`'s `motion.span` backgroundSize sweep, plus the unused dead `HeroHighlight` export). In `src/components/sections/FirstSection.astro:12`, replace `<Highlight className="text-black-1">...` with a plain `<span>` carrying the same static gradient classes (`bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-300 to-purple-300 rounded-lg px-1 pb-1`) — no animation, gradient just renders immediately.
- **`src/components/ui/HoverEffect.tsx`** — used in `Projects.astro` for the hover-highlight-behind-card effect on GitHub project cards. Rewrite without `framer-motion`/`AnimatePresence`/`useState`: put the highlight `<span>` in every card unconditionally with `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-150` (Tailwind `group`/`group-hover`) instead of tracking `hoveredIndex` in JS. This drops the component to a plain function with no hooks, so `Projects.astro:85` no longer needs `client:visible` — one less hydrated island.
- **`src/components/ui/AnimatedCard.tsx`** — strip the unused framer-motion-based exports: `AnimatedCard` (dead demo component, not imported anywhere), `Skeleton`, `Container`, and `CardSkeletonContainer` (only consumed by the two above). Keep `Card`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription` — they're plain styled wrappers reused across every section and stay framer-free already. Leave the filename as-is to avoid touching every import site.
- **`src/styles/globals.css:29-38`** — remove `.animate-move` utility and the `@keyframes move` block (only consumer was the now-deleted `Skeleton`).
- **`package.json`** — remove `framer-motion` from dependencies; run `pnpm install` to update the lockfile. `@astrojs/react` stays (still needed to compile the static `Card`/`CardTitle`/`CardDescription` `.tsx` components).

After this, the homepage ships **zero client-side hydration** for cards/hero/projects — everything renders as static HTML at build time.

## 2. Tone down the remaining decorative animation

- **`src/components/Icons/Smily.astro`** and **`src/components/Icons/Heart.astro`** — both run a one-time "draw the squiggle" stroke animation on load (`@keyframes draw`, 1–3s). Remove the `animation`/`stroke-dasharray`/`stroke-dashoffset` styling so the icons just render as static strokes immediately (keep the SVGs/paths themselves — they're decorative content, not motion).
- Leave the small CSS-only hover states as-is — they're reasonable, not "wobble": nav link lift (`NavBar.astro:13`), skill-badge border (`Skills.astro:12`), project-card border (kept only if ProjectLinks survives — see below), and the new CSS hover-fade in `HoverEffect`.

## 3. Reduce homepage content

- **Remove the Contact section**: delete `<Contact />` from `src/pages/index.astro`, delete `src/components/sections/Contact.astro`. Footer (`src/components/Footer.astro`) already lists the same social links — no information lost.
- **Remove ProjectLinks entirely**: delete `<ProjectLinks />` from `src/pages/index.astro`, delete `src/components/sections/ProjectLinks.astro`, delete the `projectLinks` export from `src/consts.ts:135-164`. The live "Cool things" GitHub pinned-repos section (`Projects.astro`) already shows real, working projects — this removes the 3 "Upcoming" placeholders with no links (Ye job tracker, Sirdab, link shortener), which read as unfinished promises.
- **`src/pages/index.astro`** final section order: `FirstSection`, `OverView`, `ProfessionalExperience`, `Skills`, `Projects` (5 sections, down from 7).
- **Trim `ProfessionalExperience.astro:24-30`**: remove the informal aside under the freelance entry ("Also, If you have a business... I will send out an ad soon for this.") — reads as an unfinished note rather than content. Keep the factual freelance description.
- **`src/consts.ts`**: remove the duplicate `MongoDB` entry in `skillSet` (appears twice, lines 84-87 and 129-132).
- **`src/pages/services.astro:18`**: remove the hardcoded `Latest update: Aug 16` span — it's a manually-maintained date that will silently go stale.

## 4. SEO hardening

- **Structured data (the actual gap)**: add a `Person` JSON-LD block (name, jobTitle, url, sameAs → social links from `consts.ts`) in `src/components/BaseHead.astro`, output via a `<script type="application/ld+json">`. This is the one thing currently missing versus the otherwise-complete OG/Twitter/canonical/favicon/robots/sitemap setup.
- **`llms.txt`** (`public/llms.txt`) — already exists and is in decent shape. Lightly refresh it to match the trimmed content: keep as source-of-truth style summary, no changes strictly required by the section removals since it doesn't reference ProjectLinks/Contact specifically — just re-read after content edits land and confirm it's still accurate.
- **Gate the Databuddy script** in `BaseHead.astro:79-86` behind `import.meta.env.PROD` (it currently loads unconditionally, including in local dev, unlike the gtag script right above it which already does this correctly).
- **Verify the OG image** (`public/group-1.png`, referenced as the default `og:image`/`twitter:image` in `BaseHead.astro`) is close to the recommended 1200×630 social-card aspect ratio; note actual dimensions during verification, adjust only if noticeably off.
- **`README.md`**: fix `npm run dev/build/preview` → `pnpm run dev/build/preview` (project uses pnpm per `packageManager` field and `pnpm-lock.yaml`).

## Verification

1. `pnpm build` — confirm 0 errors/warnings from `astro check`, confirm `dist/index.html`, `dist/services/index.html`, `dist/sitemap-index.xml`, `dist/robots.txt`, `dist/llms.txt` all still generate.
2. `pnpm dev` (or `pnpm preview` against the build) — open in the Browser tool:
   - Home page: confirm cards render with static borders (no tilt on mouse move), hero tagline shows the gradient highlight immediately (no sweep-in), hovering a "Cool things" project card shows the highlight via CSS only, confirm Contact/ProjectLinks sections are gone and page still reads coherently top-to-bottom.
   - Services page: confirm the stale date line is gone.
   - Check browser console for JS errors (`read_console_messages`) and confirm no `framer-motion` chunk is requested (`read_network_requests`).
3. View page source (or `curl`) for `/` and confirm the `application/ld+json` Person block is present and valid (no trailing commas etc.).
4. Re-run the sitemap/robots/llms.txt checks against the local build output to confirm nothing regressed.
5. `grep -r framer-motion src/ package.json` — confirm zero remaining references before removing the dependency.

# Simplify content, cut motion, strengthen SEO

## Context

The site (Astro + React islands + Tailwind, deployed as static assets on Cloudflare Workers) has grown a bit heavy: nearly every homepage card wraps in a mouse-tracking "wobble" tilt effect (`framer-motion`), the hero tagline sweeps in with an animated gradient, two sections overlap in purpose (a hardcoded "project links" list duplicates the live GitHub projects feed, 3 of its 4 entries are unreleased placeholders), and a contact section on the homepage duplicates the footer's social links. The goal is a calmer, more scannable, more honest page — less JS, less motion, fewer redundant sections — plus baseline SEO hardening (llms.txt already exists; add structured data and tidy a couple of loose ends).

Confirmed live: `https://saranatour.dev/sitemap-index.xml` already resolves correctly — despite the branch name, no sitemap-404 fix is needed.

Content decisions below reflect the user's answers: remove the Contact section (footer already covers it), remove ProjectLinks entirely (overlaps with live GitHub projects, 3/4 entries are "Upcoming" placeholders), and remove `framer-motion` entirely in favor of plain CSS hover transitions.

## 1. Remove framer-motion, replace with plain CSS

Delete the dependency entirely once these are converted — no JS-driven motion should remain except plain CSS `transition`/`:hover`.

- **`src/components/ui/WobbleCard.tsx`** — delete. It's the mouse-tilt "wobble" (`onMouseMove` → `translate3d`) wrapped around nearly every card.
- **`src/components/CardWrapper.astro`** — currently a thin wrapper that hydrates `WobbleCard` (`client:visible`/`client:idle`). Replace with a plain `<div>` carrying the same container classes (`border border-blue-1 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden ...`) — no React, no hydration, no `enableWobble` prop needed. Every section (`FirstSection`, `OverView`, `ProfessionalExperience`, `Skills`, `services.astro`) keeps importing `CardWrapper` unchanged, just gets a static box instead of a hydrated one.
- **`src/components/ui/Highlight.tsx`** — delete (`Highlight`'s `motion.span` backgroundSize sweep, plus the unused dead `HeroHighlight` export). In `src/components/sections/FirstSection.astro:12`, replace `<Highlight className="text-black-1">...` with a plain `<span>` carrying the same static gradient classes (`bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-300 to-purple-300 rounded-lg px-1 pb-1`) — no animation, gradient just renders immediately.
- **`src/components/ui/HoverEffect.tsx`** — used in `Projects.astro` for the hover-highlight-behind-card effect on GitHub project cards. Rewrite without `framer-motion`/`AnimatePresence`/`useState`: put the highlight `<span>` in every card unconditionally with `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-150` (Tailwind `group`/`group-hover`) instead of tracking `hoveredIndex` in JS. This drops the component to a plain function with no hooks, so `Projects.astro:85` no longer needs `client:visible` — one less hydrated island.
- **`src/components/ui/AnimatedCard.tsx`** — strip the unused framer-motion-based exports: `AnimatedCard` (dead demo component, not imported anywhere), `Skeleton`, `Container`, and `CardSkeletonContainer` (only consumed by the two above). Keep `Card`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription` — they're plain styled wrappers reused across every section and stay framer-free already. Leave the filename as-is to avoid touching every import site.
- **`src/styles/globals.css:29-38`** — remove `.animate-move` utility and the `@keyframes move` block (only consumer was the now-deleted `Skeleton`).
- **`package.json`** — remove `framer-motion` from dependencies; run `pnpm install` to update the lockfile. `@astrojs/react` stays (still needed to compile the static `Card`/`CardTitle`/`CardDescription` `.tsx` components).

## 3. Reduce homepage content

# Simplify content, cut motion, strengthen SEO

## Context

The site (Astro + React islands + Tailwind, deployed as static assets on Cloudflare Workers) has grown a bit heavy: nearly every homepage card wraps in a mouse-tracking "wobble" tilt effect (`framer-motion`), the hero tagline sweeps in with an animated gradient, two sections overlap in purpose (a hardcoded "project links" list duplicates the live GitHub projects feed, 3 of its 4 entries are unreleased placeholders), and a contact section on the homepage duplicates the footer's social links. The goal is a calmer, more scannable, more honest page — less JS, less motion, fewer redundant sections — plus baseline SEO hardening (llms.txt already exists; add structured data and tidy a couple of loose ends).

Confirmed live: `https://saranatour.dev/sitemap-index.xml` already resolves correctly — despite the branch name, no sitemap-404 fix is needed.

Content decisions below reflect the user's answers: remove the Contact section (footer already covers it), remove ProjectLinks entirely (overlaps with live GitHub projects, 3/4 entries are "Upcoming" placeholders), and remove `framer-motion` entirely in favor of plain CSS hover transitions.

## 1. Remove framer-motion, replace with Tailwind utilities

Delete the dependency entirely once these are converted — no JS-driven motion should remain, only Tailwind's `transition`/`hover:`/`group-hover:` utilities (the same pattern already used elsewhere in the codebase, e.g. `NavBar.astro:13`, `Contact.astro:18`).

- **`src/components/ui/WobbleCard.tsx`** — delete. It's the mouse-tilt "wobble" (`onMouseMove` → `translate3d`) wrapped around nearly every card.
- **`src/components/CardWrapper.astro`** — currently a thin wrapper that hydrates `WobbleCard` (`client:visible`/`client:idle`). Replace with a plain `<div>` reusing the exact same Tailwind container classes it already passes through today (`border border-blue-1 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden ...` via `containerClassName`/`className` props) — no React, no hydration, no `enableWobble` prop needed. Every section (`FirstSection`, `OverView`, `ProfessionalExperience`, `Skills`, `services.astro`) keeps importing `CardWrapper` unchanged, just gets a static box instead of a hydrated one. Nothing new is hardcoded — the class strings already exist in `WobbleCard.tsx`/call sites today, just moved into a plain `.astro` template.
- **`src/components/ui/Highlight.tsx`** — delete (`Highlight`'s `motion.span` backgroundSize sweep, plus the unused dead `HeroHighlight` export). In `src/components/sections/FirstSection.astro:12`, replace `<Highlight className="text-black-1">...` with a plain `<span>` reusing the exact Tailwind classes already on `Highlight`'s wrapper (`bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-300 to-purple-300 rounded-lg px-1 pb-1`) — no animation, gradient just renders immediately, no new colors/values introduced.
- **`src/components/ui/HoverEffect.tsx`** — used in `Projects.astro` for the hover-highlight-behind-card effect on GitHub project cards. Rewrite without `framer-motion`/`AnimatePresence`/`useState`: put the highlight `<span>` in every card unconditionally with Tailwind's `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-150` on the existing `group` wrapper, instead of tracking `hoveredIndex` in JS — same `bg-blue-1/50` fill it already uses, just driven by CSS instead of state. This drops the component to a plain function with no hooks, so `Projects.astro:85` no longer needs `client:visible` — one less hydrated island.
- **`src/components/ui/AnimatedCard.tsx`** — strip the unused framer-motion-based exports: `AnimatedCard` (dead demo component, not imported anywhere), `Skeleton`, `Container`, and `CardSkeletonContainer` (only consumed by the two above). Keep `Card`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription` — they're plain styled wrappers reused across every section and stay framer-free already. Leave the filename as-is to avoid touching every import site.
- **`src/styles/globals.css:29-38`** — remove `.animate-move` utility and the `@keyframes move` block (only consumer was the now-deleted `Skeleton`).
- **`package.json`** — remove `framer-motion` from dependencies; run `pnpm install` to update the lockfile. `@astrojs/react` stays (still needed to compile the static `Card`/`CardTitle`/`CardDescription` `.tsx` components).

After this, the homepage ships **zero client-side hydration** for cards/hero/projects — everything renders as static HTML at build time.

## 2. Tone down the remaining decorative animation

- **`src/components/Icons/Smily.astro`** and **`src/components/Icons/Heart.astro`** — both run a one-time "draw the squiggle" stroke animation on load (`@keyframes draw`, 1–3s). Remove the `animation`/`stroke-dasharray`/`stroke-dashoffset` styling so the icons just render as static strokes immediately (keep the SVGs/paths themselves — they're decorative content, not motion).
- Leave the small CSS-only hover states as-is — they're reasonable, not "wobble": nav link lift (`NavBar.astro:13`), skill-badge border (`Skills.astro:12`), project-card border (kept only if ProjectLinks survives — see below), and the new CSS hover-fade in `HoverEffect`.

## 3. Reduce homepage content

- **Remove the Contact section**: delete `<Contact />` from `src/pages/index.astro`, delete `src/components/sections/Contact.astro`. Footer (`src/components/Footer.astro`) already lists the same social links — no information lost.
- **Remove ProjectLinks entirely**: delete `<ProjectLinks />` from `src/pages/index.astro`, delete `src/components/sections/ProjectLinks.astro`, delete the `projectLinks` export from `src/consts.ts:135-164`. The live "Cool things" GitHub pinned-repos section (`Projects.astro`) already shows real, working projects — this removes the 3 "Upcoming" placeholders with no links (Ye job tracker, Sirdab, link shortener), which read as unfinished promises.
- **`src/pages/index.astro`** final section order: `FirstSection`, `OverView`, `ProfessionalExperience`, `Skills`, `Projects` (5 sections, down from 7).
- **Trim `ProfessionalExperience.astro:24-30`**: remove the informal aside under the freelance entry ("Also, If you have a business... I will send out an ad soon for this.") — reads as an unfinished note rather than content. Keep the factual freelance description.
- **`src/consts.ts`**: remove the duplicate `MongoDB` entry in `skillSet` (appears twice, lines 84-87 and 129-132).
- **`src/pages/services.astro:18`**: remove the hardcoded `Latest update: Aug 16` span — it's a manually-maintained date that will silently go stale.

## 4. SEO hardening

- **Structured data (the actual gap)**: add a `Person` JSON-LD block (name, jobTitle, url, sameAs → social links from `consts.ts`) in `src/components/BaseHead.astro`, output via a `<script type="application/ld+json">`. This is the one thing currently missing versus the otherwise-complete OG/Twitter/canonical/favicon/robots/sitemap setup.
- **`llms.txt`** (`public/llms.txt`) — already exists and is in decent shape. Lightly refresh it to match the trimmed content: keep as source-of-truth style summary, no changes strictly required by the section removals since it doesn't reference ProjectLinks/Contact specifically — just re-read after content edits land and confirm it's still accurate.
- **Gate the Databuddy script** in `BaseHead.astro:79-86` behind `import.meta.env.PROD` (it currently loads unconditionally, including in local dev, unlike the gtag script right above it which already does this correctly).
- **Verify the OG image** (`public/group-1.png`, referenced as the default `og:image`/`twitter:image` in `BaseHead.astro`) is close to the recommended 1200×630 social-card aspect ratio; note actual dimensions during verification, adjust only if noticeably off.
- **`README.md`**: fix `npm run dev/build/preview` → `pnpm run dev/build/preview` (project uses pnpm per `packageManager` field and `pnpm-lock.yaml`).

## Verification

1. `pnpm build` — confirm 0 errors/warnings from `astro check`, confirm `dist/index.html`, `dist/services/index.html`, `dist/sitemap-index.xml`, `dist/robots.txt`, `dist/llms.txt` all still generate.
2. `pnpm dev` (or `pnpm preview` against the build) — open in the Browser tool:
   - Home page: confirm cards render with static borders (no tilt on mouse move), hero tagline shows the gradient highlight immediately (no sweep-in), hovering a "Cool things" project card shows the highlight via CSS only, confirm Contact/ProjectLinks sections are gone and page still reads coherently top-to-bottom.
   - Services page: confirm the stale date line is gone.
   - Check browser console for JS errors (`read_console_messages`) and confirm no `framer-motion` chunk is requested (`read_network_requests`).
3. View page source (or `curl`) for `/` and confirm the `application/ld+json` Person block is present and valid (no trailing commas etc.).
4. Re-run the sitemap/robots/llms.txt checks against the local build output to confirm nothing regressed.
5. `grep -r framer-motion src/ package.json` — confirm zero remaining references before removing the dependency.

# Simplify content, cut motion, strengthen SEO

## Context

The site (Astro + React islands + Tailwind, deployed as static assets on Cloudflare Workers) has grown a bit heavy: nearly every homepage card wraps in a mouse-tracking "wobble" tilt effect (`framer-motion`), the hero tagline sweeps in with an animated gradient, two sections overlap in purpose (a hardcoded "project links" list duplicates the live GitHub projects feed, 3 of its 4 entries are unreleased placeholders), and a contact section on the homepage duplicates the footer's social links. The goal is a calmer, more scannable, more honest page — less JS, less motion, fewer redundant sections — plus baseline SEO hardening (llms.txt already exists; add structured data and tidy a couple of loose ends).

Confirmed live: `https://saranatour.dev/sitemap-index.xml` already resolves correctly — despite the branch name, no sitemap-404 fix is needed.

Content decisions below reflect the user's answers: remove the Contact section (footer already covers it), remove ProjectLinks entirely (overlaps with live GitHub projects, 3/4 entries are "Upcoming" placeholders), and remove `framer-motion` entirely in favor of plain CSS hover transitions.

## 1. Remove framer-motion, replace with Tailwind utilities

Delete the dependency entirely once these are converted — no JS-driven motion should remain, only Tailwind's `transition`/`hover:`/`group-hover:` utilities (the same pattern already used elsewhere in the codebase, e.g. `NavBar.astro:13`, `Contact.astro:18`).

- **`src/components/ui/WobbleCard.tsx`** — delete. It's the mouse-tilt "wobble" (`onMouseMove` → `translate3d`) wrapped around nearly every card.
- **`src/components/CardWrapper.astro`** — currently a thin wrapper that hydrates `WobbleCard` (`client:visible`/`client:idle`). Replace with a plain `<div>` reusing the exact same Tailwind container classes it already passes through today (`border border-blue-1 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden ...` via `containerClassName`/`className` props) — no React, no hydration, no `enableWobble` prop needed. Every section (`FirstSection`, `OverView`, `ProfessionalExperience`, `Skills`, `services.astro`) keeps importing `CardWrapper` unchanged, just gets a static box instead of a hydrated one. Nothing new is hardcoded — the class strings already exist in `WobbleCard.tsx`/call sites today, just moved into a plain `.astro` template.
- **`src/components/ui/Highlight.tsx`** — delete (`Highlight`'s `motion.span` backgroundSize sweep, plus the unused dead `HeroHighlight` export). In `src/components/sections/FirstSection.astro:12`, replace `<Highlight className="text-black-1">...` with a plain `<span>` reusing the exact Tailwind classes already on `Highlight`'s wrapper (`bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-300 to-purple-300 rounded-lg px-1 pb-1`) — no animation, gradient just renders immediately, no new colors/values introduced.
- **`src/components/ui/HoverEffect.tsx`** — used in `Projects.astro` for the hover-highlight-behind-card effect on GitHub project cards. Rewrite without `framer-motion`/`AnimatePresence`/`useState`: put the highlight `<span>` in every card unconditionally with Tailwind's `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-150` on the existing `group` wrapper, instead of tracking `hoveredIndex` in JS — same `bg-blue-1/50` fill it already uses, just driven by CSS instead of state. This drops the component to a plain function with no hooks, so `Projects.astro:85` no longer needs `client:visible` — one less hydrated island.
- **`src/components/ui/AnimatedCard.tsx`** — strip the unused framer-motion-based exports: `AnimatedCard` (dead demo component, not imported anywhere), `Skeleton`, `Container`, and `CardSkeletonContainer` (only consumed by the two above). Keep `Card`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription` — they're plain styled wrappers reused across every section and stay framer-free already. Leave the filename as-is to avoid touching every import site.
- **`src/styles/globals.css:29-38`** — remove `.animate-move` utility and the `@keyframes move` block (only consumer was the now-deleted `Skeleton`).
- **`package.json`** — remove `framer-motion` from dependencies; run `pnpm install` to update the lockfile. `@astrojs/react` stays (still needed to compile the static `Card`/`CardTitle`/`CardDescription` `.tsx` components).

After this, the homepage ships **zero client-side hydration** for cards/hero/projects — everything renders as static HTML at build time.

## 2. Tone down the remaining decorative animation

- **`src/components/Icons/Smily.astro`** and **`src/components/Icons/Heart.astro`** — both run a one-time "draw the squiggle" stroke animation on load (`@keyframes draw`, 1–3s). Remove the `animation`/`stroke-dasharray`/`stroke-dashoffset` styling so the icons just render as static strokes immediately (keep the SVGs/paths themselves — they're decorative content, not motion).
- Leave the small existing Tailwind hover utilities as-is — they're reasonable, not "wobble": nav link lift (`NavBar.astro:13`), skill-badge border (`Skills.astro:12`), and the new `group-hover` fade in `HoverEffect`.

## 3. Reduce homepage content

- **Remove the Contact section**: delete `<Contact />` from `src/pages/index.astro`, delete `src/components/sections/Contact.astro`. Footer (`src/components/Footer.astro`) already lists the same social links — no information lost.
- **Remove ProjectLinks entirely**: delete `<ProjectLinks />` from `src/pages/index.astro`, delete `src/components/sections/ProjectLinks.astro`, delete the `projectLinks` export from `src/consts.ts:135-164`. The live "Cool things" GitHub pinned-repos section (`Projects.astro`) already shows real, working projects — this removes the 3 "Upcoming" placeholders with no links (Ye job tracker, Sirdab, link shortener), which read as unfinished promises.
- **`src/pages/index.astro`** final section order: `FirstSection`, `OverView`, `ProfessionalExperience`, `Skills`, `Projects` (5 sections, down from 7).
- **Trim `ProfessionalExperience.astro:24-30`**: remove the informal aside under the freelance entry ("Also, If you have a business... I will send out an ad soon for this.") — reads as an unfinished note rather than content. Keep the factual freelance description.
- **`src/consts.ts`**: remove the duplicate `MongoDB` entry in `skillSet` (appears twice, lines 84-87 and 129-132).
- **`src/pages/services.astro:18`**: remove the hardcoded `Latest update: Aug 16` span — it's a manually-maintained date that will silently go stale.

## 4. SEO hardening

- **Structured data (the actual gap)**: add a `Person` JSON-LD block (name, jobTitle, url, sameAs → social links from `consts.ts`) in `src/components/BaseHead.astro`, output via a `<script type="application/ld+json">`. This is the one thing currently missing versus the otherwise-complete OG/Twitter/canonical/favicon/robots/sitemap setup.
- **`llms.txt`** (`public/llms.txt`) — already exists and is in decent shape. Lightly refresh it to match the trimmed content: keep as source-of-truth style summary, no changes strictly required by the section removals since it doesn't reference ProjectLinks/Contact specifically — just re-read after content edits land and confirm it's still accurate.
- **Gate the Databuddy script** in `BaseHead.astro:79-86` behind `import.meta.env.PROD` (it currently loads unconditionally, including in local dev, unlike the gtag script right above it which already does this correctly).
- **Verify the OG image** (`public/group-1.png`, referenced as the default `og:image`/`twitter:image` in `BaseHead.astro`) is close to the recommended 1200×630 social-card aspect ratio; note actual dimensions during verification, adjust only if noticeably off.
- **`README.md`**: fix `npm run dev/build/preview` → `pnpm run dev/build/preview` (project uses pnpm per `packageManager` field and `pnpm-lock.yaml`).

## Verification

1. `pnpm build` — confirm 0 errors/warnings from `astro check`, confirm `dist/index.html`, `dist/services/index.html`, `dist/sitemap-index.xml`, `dist/robots.txt`, `dist/llms.txt` all still generate.
2. `pnpm dev` (or `pnpm preview` against the build) — open in the Browser tool:
   - Home page: confirm cards render with static borders (no tilt on mouse move), hero tagline shows the gradient highlight immediately (no sweep-in), hovering a "Cool things" project card shows the highlight via CSS only, confirm Contact/ProjectLinks sections are gone and page still reads coherently top-to-bottom.
   - Services page: confirm the stale date line is gone.
   - Check browser console for JS errors (`read_console_messages`) and confirm no `framer-motion` chunk is requested (`read_network_requests`).
3. View page source (or `curl`) for `/` and confirm the `application/ld+json` Person block is present and valid (no trailing commas etc.).
4. Re-run the sitemap/robots/llms.txt checks against the local build output to confirm nothing regressed.
5. `grep -r framer-motion src/ package.json` — confirm zero remaining references before removing the dependency.

# Simplify content, cut motion, strengthen SEO

## Context

The site (Astro + React islands + Tailwind, deployed as static assets on Cloudflare Workers) has grown a bit heavy: nearly every homepage card wraps in a mouse-tracking "wobble" tilt effect (`framer-motion`), the hero tagline sweeps in with an animated gradient, two sections overlap in purpose (a hardcoded "project links" list duplicates the live GitHub projects feed, 3 of its 4 entries are unreleased placeholders), and a contact section on the homepage duplicates the footer's social links. The goal is a calmer, more scannable, more honest page — less JS, less motion, fewer redundant sections — plus baseline SEO hardening (llms.txt already exists; add structured data and tidy a couple of loose ends).

Confirmed live: `https://saranatour.dev/sitemap-index.xml` already resolves correctly — despite the branch name, no sitemap-404 fix is needed.

Content decisions below reflect the user's answers: remove the Contact section (footer already covers it), remove ProjectLinks entirely (overlaps with live GitHub projects, 3/4 entries are "Upcoming" placeholders), and remove `framer-motion` entirely in favor of Tailwind's existing hover/transition utilities.

## 1. Remove framer-motion, replace with Tailwind utilities

Delete the dependency entirely once these are converted — no JS-driven motion should remain, only Tailwind's `transition`/`hover:`/`group-hover:` utilities (the same pattern already used elsewhere in the codebase, e.g. `NavBar.astro:13`, `Contact.astro:18`).

- **`src/components/ui/WobbleCard.tsx`** — delete. It's the mouse-tilt "wobble" (`onMouseMove` → `translate3d`) wrapped around nearly every card.
- **`src/components/CardWrapper.astro`** — currently a thin wrapper that hydrates `WobbleCard` (`client:visible`/`client:idle`). Replace with a plain `<div>` reusing the exact same Tailwind container classes it already passes through today (`border border-blue-1 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden ...` via `containerClassName`/`className` props) — no React, no hydration, no `enableWobble` prop needed. Every section (`FirstSection`, `OverView`, `ProfessionalExperience`, `Skills`, `services.astro`) keeps importing `CardWrapper` unchanged, just gets a static box instead of a hydrated one. Nothing new is hardcoded — the class strings already exist in `WobbleCard.tsx`/call sites today, just moved into a plain `.astro` template.
- **`src/components/ui/Highlight.tsx`** — delete (`Highlight`'s `motion.span` backgroundSize sweep, plus the unused dead `HeroHighlight` export). In `src/components/sections/FirstSection.astro:12`, replace `<Highlight className="text-black-1">...` with a plain `<span>` reusing the exact Tailwind classes already on `Highlight`'s wrapper (`bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-300 to-purple-300 rounded-lg px-1 pb-1`) — no animation, gradient just renders immediately, no new colors/values introduced.
- **`src/components/ui/HoverEffect.tsx`** — used in `Projects.astro` for the hover-highlight-behind-card effect on GitHub project cards. Rewrite without `framer-motion`/`AnimatePresence`/`useState`: put the highlight `<span>` in every card unconditionally with Tailwind's `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-150` on the existing `group` wrapper, instead of tracking `hoveredIndex` in JS — same `bg-blue-1/50` fill it already uses, just driven by CSS instead of state. This drops the component to a plain function with no hooks, so `Projects.astro:85` no longer needs `client:visible` — one less hydrated island.
- **`src/components/ui/AnimatedCard.tsx`** — strip the unused framer-motion-based exports: `AnimatedCard` (dead demo component, not imported anywhere), `Skeleton`, `Container`, and `CardSkeletonContainer` (only consumed by the two above). # Sara Natour's Personal Website
 Personal website, simple

##  Tech Stack

This project is built using:
- [Astro](https://astro.build/) - Web framework for content-driven websites
- [React](https://reactjs.org/) - UI component library
- [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) - Utility-first CSS framework
- [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) - Typed JavaScript

## 🧞 Local Development

All commands are run from the root of the project, from a terminal:

| Command                   | Action                                           |
| :------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------- |
| `npm install`             | Installs dependencies                            |
| `npm run dev`             | Starts local dev server at `localhost:4321`      |
| `npm run build`           | Build your production site to `./dist/`          |
| `npm run preview`         | Preview your build locally, before deploying     |

## 📬 Contact

Want to work together? Check out the Services page or reach out directly!

import { ClientRouter } from 'astro:transitions';
import { socialLinks } from '../consts';
